title: First Time Mallworld Dreamer.
content: **The beginning** I had a weird dream happening. which is pretty normal for me, as I dream about many diferent realities. but my first time experiencing such a strange phenomenon as the mallworld. It starts out as me and my mom are watching someone do donuts in a parking lot (average blue WRX) and then someone flies right out. with my moms car and her in it, I race over to see if he's okay, and hop out. *(This is when people start to slowly show up, the area around us morphing and changing to the front of the mall.)* The guy says he's fine, all bloody and goes back into his car and vrooms off, the car i was in is gone, and more people start to show up. i then see my mom ushering me over to the front of the mall. The front of this mall looks strange, almost like there were tons of market stands with plushies, jewelry, things in glass boxes, and strange vendors, they all gave me "there's no war in ba-sing-sae" vibes. as I'm looking around in awe. the mall starts morphing around me, ***I'm now inside of the mall.*** The moment i turn around there's is clothes, furry items like y2k style, and people stealing... one person yells at me saying you can steal whatever you want! then a bathroom appears where they are running, and i hear distant screaming from that said person. It semes like in my version of the mall, the restrooms kind of determine what happens to you if you do something bad, like this crazy person who thinks they can steal items, and get trapped in the restroom. there are also others, running around stealing items, but the crazy thing is, the vendors' aren't doing anything, but just watching them. **Stealing Fiasco** Then someone tried to steal things off of me, like my phone. so I did what anyone would do and chase them! I was letting others know that they stole my phone while I was trying to catch them. going in loops and circles around this mall. I soon got to a point where I cornered them, and grabbed my phone back. then they were gone, and Infront of me wasn't a corner anymore, but a restroom. i had a profound feeling to go in, and what i saw what the person who stole my phone stuck in this endless black void with the mall screaming at them in agony and pain, they were shaking and crying. but this was just one little stall that he was in, the rest of the restroom was normal unsettling vibes, but i could tell there was no evil intent, it was just run down and has a tiny smell of mildew and cleaning chemicals. so, you cant steal from the mall, or things off of other people, and restrooms were a way to reward, or punish your behavior. so after that, i wash up, splash some water on my face, and start venturing to the mall. **Time to Have Fun at The Mall World!** After that strange reaction, i starter walking around to see all the fancy fun clothes. people are grabbing items to try in changing rooms, and some people stuck in restrooms because they took the clothes in the restroom, and didn't pay for them. but i start venturing off to to other areas of the mall, the jewelry, the diferent clothing brand areas, and seeing some restaurants. This one area that i walked into looked like something out of Greece Rochester mall *(a mall in NY that's slowly shutting down)*. with 4 attraction's in the center. they had vendors that still looked like they were in ba-sing sae. but they were walking around grabbing people to play their games, one had stuffed animals, and apparency an expensive protogen that was moveable for thousands of dollars. i was fixated on this, and the vendor asked "would you like to play?" i declined softly saying "sorry, i need to go wash up first!" and the vendor kindly pointed me to a restroom. as i head into this restroom, i find two small rooms. and a lady with her kids is in one, she's using the bathroom with her little ones. so i got into the next stall, i say out loud *"why is there a shower in this stall?"* and the lady in the other stall says *"the Mall has a way of telling you what you need, sometimes its using the bathroom, other times, its taking a shower! treat these restrooms as a gift!"* i thanked her and ask her what her name was, i got the name Maisey Mae? *(if anyone here is Maisey Mae, thank you!)* I took that with a grain of salt, then see another room, with a TV and a chair, and surrounding it is full of clothes. so of course i go take a quick shower, come out, and find clothes to get dressed in. Then I got sucked into the tv, playing this scene over and over again that felt like a stoner trap, almost something uncanny that i remember, with soundtracks from enter the void ***(I DO NOT RECOMEND WATCHING IT!)*** if i remember correctly, it was a mix of back at the barnyard, poorly animated brain rot, and the sound track from Farmville, and noise of enter the void. Then someone else comes into the room with me and asks if they have NCIS, and where is the remote. the tv automatically changes channels from what I was watching, so its the mall changing the tv, I ask the tv kindly to change to NCIS for my friend, and it does so, taking a bit to find an episode of NCIS. but after that, i find some clothes, head out, and find the same attraction, and also other stores to my right, following with a food court and the smell of chemicals, and grilled items. (mmm we love to smell a clean mall) and to my left, there's this glass escalator, and a little Japanese restaurant next to the escalators. but i go back to the 4 attractions, telling the vendor I'm back from a quick wash up, and as I'm about to play the game, she suggest me to try and play the other games before this one, the 4 attractions are linked together if i want the giant animatronic protogen. so i obliged, play the other 3, then when i start to see the vendor again for the plushies, i wake up. ngl, i was pretty sad that i couldn't get the protogen... but i was stoked when i woke up.
